name: localagent
description: A local-first autonomous coding agent for macOS and Windows — bring your own model (embedded GGUF, Ollama/LM Studio/vLLM, Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, or a bundled free-tier router), with a real agent loop, permission engine, MCP tools, cross-provider fallback, and multi-session desktop UI.
author: Chandu Lavu
